description: This Java class defines an AutoDictionary for an Android keyboard application, managing temporary word storage and promotion to a user dictionary based on usage thresholds.

classes.name: AutoDictionary
classes.description: A class that manages an auto-dictionary for an Android keyboard, temporarily storing new words and promoting frequently used words to the user dictionary.

methods.name: AutoDictionary
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the auto-dictionary, setting up preferences and thresholds.

methods.name: createStorage
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SQLite connection for storing words.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Always returns false; words in auto-dictionary are considered invalid.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a word to the auto-dictionary, promoting it to the user dictionary if it exceeds the usage threshold.

methods.name: closeStorage
methods.description: Disposes of preferences subscription and closes storage resources.
